module_signature.description: Serial load enable; shift one bit per rising edge while high
module_signature.name: load_en

module_signature.description: Serial data in, key MSB-first then plaintext MSB-first
module_signature.name: din

module_signature.description: Serial unload enable; shift ciphertext out while high and done asserted
module_signature.name: shift_out_en

module_signature.description: Serial data out; drives state[63] while unloading, 0 otherwise
module_signature.name: dout

module_signature.description: Asserted when ciphertext is fully computed; held until reset or new load
module_signature.name: done

Implement PRESENT-80 block cipher reference model with bit-serial I/O
SBOX constant 64'h21748FE3DA09B65C means nibble index x -> SBOX[4*x+:4]
The hex string 21748FE3DA09B65C encodes 16 nibbles; nibble 0 is LSB side
pLayer: P(i) = (i*16) mod 63 for i=0..62, P(63)=63
Key schedule: rotate left 61, S-box top nibble, XOR round into bits [19:15]
Final addRoundKey happens on a separate edge after round 31 key schedule
